title: Picky Venezuelan Fry-Up
description: A quick and flavorful breakfast fry-up with Venezuelan twist, featuring pickled ingredients.
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk until smooth.
Heat the quick fry batter in a pan over medium heat.
Add the scrambled eggs and stir until cooked through.
Add the pickled onions and stir-fried bell peppers to the pan.
Add the Venezuelan cheese and stir until melted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Cook the eggs to an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C) for food safety.
Cook the quick fry batter and vegetables to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C) for food safety.
